visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and round glasses, wearing a dark grey speckled sweater over a white collar, is seen in a medium close-up shot. She sits in front of a professional black studio microphone. The background is a neutral grey curtain. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures, pointing her index finger to emphasize points. (2) The scene cuts between slightly different angles of the same woman as she continues her explanation. She occasionally touches her cheeks or temples to indicate specific facial areas. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 這個東西它就是 biostimulator (膠原蛋白增生劑). (2) [Subtitle]: 刺激它自己長出一個生物刺激劑. (3) [Slogan]: #可以填充 #可以緊實 #可以長出膠原蛋白. (4) [Subtitle]: 這些東西打在蘋果肌比較凹陷，或太陽穴比較凹陷. [Variety]: \蘋果肌比較凹陷/ \太陽穴比較凹陷/. (5) [Subtitle]: 或者是我今天年紀大了，皮膚變薄了，我希望皮膚再厚一點. [Variety]: \皮膚變薄了!/. (6) [Subtitle]: 這個我們就可以打這種叫 biostimulator. (7) [Subtitle]: 它就是粉末進去之後，會被一個叫巨噬細胞的東西吃掉. (8) [Subtitle]: 那這個巨噬細胞，它就跟我們身體裡面講，開始製造膠原蛋白. [Variety]: \開始製造膠原蛋白/. (9) [Subtitle]: 那玻尿酸比較像是說，我今天這一球東西，我放到皮膚裡面去之後. (10) [Subtitle]: 它有一個體積給你做支撐，例如說打山根. (11) [Subtitle]: 像這個東西它就不適合說我要做一個尖下巴，我要做一個鼻頭. [Slogan]: #一個尖下巴 #做個鼻頭. (12) [Subtitle]: 這個東西可以做在哪裡?. (13) [Subtitle]: 例如說臉頰有點凹陷，毛孔有點粗大. [Variety]: 1.臉頰有點凹陷 2.毛孔粗大. (14) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: LINE @drx.derm 02-8985-9060 新北市三重區正義北路104號2F 台北市中山區南京東路一段96號 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a clear, calm female voice speaking in Mandarin Chinese with professional articulation. She introduces the concept of a 'biostimulator' against a backdrop of very quiet, bright studio silence. (2) A light, upbeat acoustic background music featuring a gentle guitar strum and subtle piano melody fades in. The speaker's delivery is steady and informative, explaining how the treatment stimulates collagen. No significant incidental noises are present. (3) The speaker continues to compare the biostimulator with hyaluronic acid, maintaining a friendly yet authoritative tone. The music stays consistent in the background. (4) The video concludes with a light 'ding' or chime sound effect as the speaker finishes, transitioning to the end screen where the BGM softly fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Explanation -> Comparison -> Application -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate potential clients about biostimulators (collagen stimulators) in aesthetic medicine. It explains how they work (triggering macrophage activity to produce collagen) compared to traditional fillers like hyaluronic acid (which provide physical volume). The ultimate goal is to establish the clinic's expertise and invite viewers to contact them for treatments targeting facial sagging and skin thinning.
